items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra with 50% lower pricing and faster computer-use agents
items.summary: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra at $1/$5 per million input/output tokens, roughly half the cost of its prior Terra model, while completing computer-use tasks over three times faster and cutting error rates on OpenAI's internal benchmark. It's rolling out to ChatGPT, Codex and the API.

items.headline: OpenAI says its models disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis and made new physics findings
items.summary: OpenAI announced three claimed research results in complexity theory, harmonic analysis and quantum field theory, including a disproof of the long-standing Exponential Time Hypothesis, verified in the Lean proof assistant. Outside experts, including MIT's Ryan Williams, are now reviewing the claims.

items.headline: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4, a world model with native audio generation
items.summary: Genie 4 generates interactive 3D environments from text prompts that users can navigate in real time, and is DeepMind's first world model to natively produce ambient sound, music and dialogue alongside the scene. It's launching as a limited research preview for trusted testers, paired in demos with Gemini Robotics.

items.headline: Nvidia and AMD commit $4 billion to Meta's AI infrastructure financing
items.summary: Nvidia pledged $3 billion and AMD $1 billion toward Meta's roughly $95 billion equity raise to fund data-center expansion, deepening chip-supply partnerships that include Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems and AMD's Helios racks and Instinct GPUs at Meta.

items.headline: UK launches £100m AI Biosecurity Lab backed by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind
items.summary: The UK government is funding a new independent AI Biosecurity Lab to spot and counter pathogen-related threats, with OpenAI and Anthropic each pledging up to £100m in model credits and compute access, and Google DeepMind contributing research support and Gemini model access.

items.headline: Anthropic expands into drug discovery with six research partnerships
items.summary: Anthropic announced research collaborations with six organizations developing new medicines, including Bristol Myers Squibb and Generate Biomedicines, built on its Claude Science platform, alongside its own early-stage, preclinical drug discovery work.

items.headline: AI chipmaker Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion Series E at $6.2 billion valuation
items.summary: Tenstorrent closed one of October's largest AI funding rounds, underscoring continued investor appetite for alternatives to Nvidia in AI accelerator hardware even as mega-rounds dominate the sector's headlines.

items.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic both race to claim progress on 3-SAT and complexity theory
items.summary: Following OpenAI's Exponential Time Hypothesis announcement, reports describe Anthropic posting a Claude-assisted paper on faster 3-SAT algorithms the same week, highlighting an emerging competitive dynamic between frontier labs over AI-assisted mathematical research.
